integrity: The exact finite-sample covariance follows from one-box conditioning and an explicit quadratic identity. Its two discriminants and the conservation law prove the complete sign classifications; the Diophantine family is verified algebraically. The standalone finite exact checker is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Independent and identically distributed uniform allocations to at least two boxes are essential.
No claim of independence or monotone regression follows from zero or signed covariances.
Asymptotic sign conclusions omit critical limiting ratios.
General classical occupancy-moment identities could implicitly encode the raw quadratic; independent historical-priority audit has not been performed.
title: Reentrant covariance phases of occupancy-frequency counts and sample collisions
